in_sanskrit.name: Marvansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Marvansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Marvansh is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Mar' meaning god and 'Vansh' meaning dynasty or lineage. This name symbolizes the grace and blessings of the gods upon a family and their offspring.
